main_body: A wide woven or tan panel with blue stripes, seen from above inside a brown wooden frame. It has a thin brown front lip and two short legs below.
top_band: Tan/gold surface (#d8bb68 to #bc9a45) from rows 2 to about 16. It fills nearly the whole object and has no front-edge step, so it is the slab itself, not a foreshortened top band.
evidence: The scan at x=15 shows one large tan field (rows 2-16) with blue stripe details painted across it. Below it is only a 3-row brown rim (rows 17-19) and 4 rows of stubby legs. The main body is a big flat slab seen from above, like the red top-down slab in the guide, with no real vertical front face. The 15-row 'top' is not foreshortened and is too large to be a horizontal band. The front is a thin rim plus legs, with no recess or eave shadow. Fails as a top-down plan.

style.evidence: The outline is tinted dark brown (0% neutral edge pixels), and there are no flat 5x5 fills. But the piece has only 15 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references, and its median of 12 colours per tile is below their 17 and 20. The tan ramp has about 4 steps and the brown wood only 2-3, so it is shallower than the 5-6 steps of Beodeul. Texture is limited to the stripe pattern and a few dots. The wood frame and legs are thin and plain next to the stall and well references.
